search_text: published ZDI-16-274 ZDI-CAN-3533 Joyent SmartOS dtrace Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2016-05-04 3.8 AV:L/AC:H/Au:S/C:C/I:N/A:N ['Joyent'] ['SmartOS'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose information on vulnerable installations of Joyent SmartOS.
